scope.method: Read every assigned question, reference code and validation generated code in bounded batches. Static semantic reasoning only; dataset functions were not executed. No corrected code or targets were created.

definitions.primary_category: Single dominant source of the observed validation disagreement; a specific model-pattern category can coexist with a reference issue.
definitions.model_pattern: Visible generated-code issue, independent of whether the stored reference is trustworthy. no_concrete_issue_found is not proof of correctness; uncertain is used for underdetermined statements.

reference_assessment.concrete_reference_issue: A specific contradiction, unsupported invented quantity/relation, wrong output scope, or visible formula defect in the reference. Does not identify a corrected target.
reference_assessment.statement_ambiguous_or_incomplete: The comparison depends on unresolved statement/rounding/output interpretation; no single reference correction is asserted.
reference_assessment.no_concrete_issue_found: No specific reference defect found in this bounded reading; not a proof of correctness.

definitions.train_visible_runtime_risk: Undefined name or dependency visible in the displayed function; math dependency can be satisfied by external execution context and was not tested.
definitions.confidence: Confidence in the stated observation, not confidence that an unflagged example is fully correct.
